# Voice Agent

> Full-duplex conversational voice agent loop with speech recognition, LLM generation, TTS synthesis, and barge-in interruption.

## Overview

Voice Agent is a lightweight Python voice interaction pipeline. It connects audio capture, voice activity detection (VAD), speech-to-text (ASR), streaming text completion, text-to-speech (TTS), and local speaker playback into a single interruptible feedback loop.

- **Website**: https://voice-agent-544.pages.dev/
- **Chinese Documentation**: https://voice-agent-544.pages.dev/zh/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/natelindev/voice-agent
- **License**: MIT
- **Requirements**: Python 3.11+, `uv`, PortAudio (`libportaudio2` on Linux, `brew install portaudio` on macOS)

## Architecture

1. **Capture & VAD**: 16 kHz mono float32 input in 512-sample chunks; silero/energy VAD detects speech boundaries.
2. **Transcription (ASR)**: OpenAI `whisper-1` (cloud) or local `whisper.cpp` inference server.
3. **Generation**: Streaming `gpt-4o-mini` with low-latency sentence token splitting.
4. **Synthesis (TTS)**: OpenAI `gpt-4o-mini-tts` or native macOS `say` voice synthesis.
5. **Barge-in / Interruption**: Cancellation signaling cuts playback cooperatively when user begins speaking.
6. **Interfaces**: Rich terminal dashboard (TUI) plus local WebSocket web companion.

## Quickstart

```bash
# Clone and install dependencies
git clone https://github.com/natelindev/voice-agent.git
cd voice-agent
uv sync --locked

# Preview / Simulated demo (no microphone or API key required)
uv run voice-agent --demo --web --no-open

# Live mode with OpenAI credentials
export OPENAI_API_KEY="your-api-key"
uv run voice-agent --web
```

## CLI Reference

- `--web / -w`: Start local HTTP & WebSocket companion (default port 8000).
- `--port / -p`: Companion port.
- `--no-open`: Start companion without automatically launching browser.
- `--headless / --no-tui`: Run without terminal UI.
- `--local / -l`: Select local macOS speech (`say`) + Codex backend.
- `--demo`: Simulated preview mode.
- `--headphones`: Enable voice interruption during assistant playback.
- `--verbose / -v`: Enable debug logs.
